source.source_title: Letter From an Airline Pilot (Part II)
source.why_this_clip: A man wears an old headset; one round earcup on his left ear, with its headband rising out of frame, is seen from the side. The camera moves in until the earcup fills most of the frame, and the headset itself does not move. There are no cuts in the clip, and this interval is the part where the earcup is largest.
